description: GET /v1/merchants/me/paymaster/activity - the unified paymaster feed: settled on-chain ops merged with pre-chain attempts that never reached chain (denied/dropped/submitted), newest first. Rows carry "source": onchain or prechain; denied rows carry "reason". "targets" lists every call target of the op in execution order and "target" is the first; a batch is one row. When no call was decoded, "targets" is empty and "target" is "0x"; both are null on on-chain rows recorded without call details. Filtering by onchain_success or onchain_reverted returns on-chain rows only, any other status returns pre-chain rows only. On-chain rows cover ops attributed to this merchant for EntryPoint v0.7 and v0.8. Pre-chain rows contain recorded attempts for both versions; denied_chain, denied_entrypoint, denied_origin and denied_malformed are sampled (at most 20 rows per client and status per 10 minutes per API instance). Pagination is keyed on the timestamp alone, so ops sharing a timestamp across a page boundary can be skipped. Use paymaster_overview_get for aggregates without pagination loss; its attempt totals still exclude unrecorded denials. Pass nextCursor back as cursor for the next page. Read-only.

cursor.description: ISO timestamp from the previous page's nextCursor; returns rows strictly older than it.

mode.description: Filters on the chain-proved mode; on-chain rows recorded without a mode are excluded from a filtered result.

name: paymaster_activity_list
title: List merchant paymaster activity
